name: @causeway-services/play
description: play.561.group -- Causeway Services' progressively enhanced game shelf, generated from @red-cup-engineering/cartridge manifests.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext test/*.test.mts && for f in serve.mjs js/*.mjs build.mjs scripts/*.mjs src/shelf/*.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
